newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF -Production centre to stay in Germany.
newsitem.headline: BASF -Production centre to stay in Germany.

text.p: German chemical company BASF AG said it intended to maintain its Ludwigshafen operations as the main centre of its production and would continue to invest two billion marks per year there.

The company said at a news conference that it set this goal up until the year 2010. But it also warned that a high level of flexibility would be required to ensure cost-effective and efficient production at the plants there.

BASF said it planned to promote part-time work to help secure jobs and would test new forms of work organisation. Pay would be more merit-based and tied more closely to profits. Redundancies would be avoided if this was at all possible.
